mapper.select: SELECT i.* FROM payment_item i WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND i.start_time <= NOW() AND i.end_time >= NOW() AND ( i.target_scope = 'ALL' OR (i.target_scope = 'COMPOSITE' AND (JSON_LENGTH(COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.scope_value, '$.grades'), JSON_ARRAY())) = 0 OR JSON_CONTAINS(i.scope_value, JSON_QUOTE(CAST(#{grade} AS CHAR)), '$.grades')) AND (JSON_LENGTH(COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.scope_value, '$.colleges'), JSON_ARRAY())) = 0 OR JSON_CONTAINS(i.scope_value, JSON_QUOTE(CAST(#{college} AS CHAR)), '$.colleges')) AND (JSON_LENGTH(COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.scope_value, '$.majors'), JSON_ARRAY())) = 0 OR JSON_CONTAINS(i.scope_value, JSON_QUOTE(CAST(#{major} AS CHAR)), '$.majors')) AND (JSON_LENGTH(COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.scope_value, '$.studentIds'), JSON_ARRAY())) = 0 OR JSON_CONTAINS(i.scope_value, JSON_QUOTE(CAST(#{studentId} AS CHAR)), '$.studentIds'))) OR (i.target_scope = 'GRADE' AND (JSON_CONTAINS(i.scope_value, JSON_QUOTE(CAST(#{grade} AS CHAR))) OR JSON_CONTAINS(i.scope_value, CAST(CAST(#{grade} AS CHAR) AS JSON)))) OR (i.target_scope = 'COLLEGE' AND JSON_CONTAINS(i.scope_value, JSON_QUOTE(CAST(#{college} AS CHAR)))) OR (i.target_scope = 'MAJOR' AND JSON_CONTAINS(i.scope_value, JSON_QUOTE(CAST(#{major} AS CHAR)))) OR (i.target_scope = 'CUSTOM' AND (JSON_CONTAINS(i.scope_value, CAST(CAST(#{studentId} AS CHAR) AS JSON)) OR JSON_CONTAINS(i.scope_value, JSON_QUOTE(CAST(#{studentId} AS CHAR))))) ) ORDER BY i.end_time ASC, i.id ASC
